record.one_liner: Meta's Marketing API and ads MCP server let developers create, manage and report on ad campaigns, ad sets, creatives and ads across Facebook, Instagram, Messenger and WhatsApp.
record.auth_notes: Marketing API: OAuth dialog (Facebook Login) with scopes ads_read / ads_management. The MCP blog says OAuth via Facebook Login for Business, or a pre-obtained access token. System user tokens are a known Meta mechanism, but I did not verify them on a fetched page.
record.access_notes: A free Meta developer app gives Limited access (the old Standard tier) right away. That tier is heavily rate-limited and meant for development, and it is enough for your own ad accounts. Managing other people's accounts or serving live advertisers needs App Review for Advanced/Full access, the Marketing API Access Tier feature, and possibly business verification. Full access requires at least 500 successful calls in 15 days with an error rate under 15%. For the MCP server, agency/partner use needs Advanced Access on ads_mcp_management. MCP tool rollout is gradual. Pricing for the MCP server is not stated on the pages I fetched. A third-party post claims it was free during open beta, which I did not verify.
record.blocker: Serving other advertisers' accounts in production requires App Review/Advanced access, and the Limited tier is heavily rate-limited. MCP tool availability is rolling out gradually.
